notes: ## CHR-1164 — "Beta" badge on the Use Cases view tab (builder spec) Revised 2026-11-21 after Christian's comment on `app-shell.tab-usecases` ("smaller, closer and higher, light blue"). **Screens:** `shell-topbar-beta-badge` (all states, light + dark), `app-shell` (tab idle, light), `usecases-list` (tab pressed; every Use Cases screen shows the same through `shell-topbar` `use-cases`). **Components:** `chrome-badge` (new), `chrome-tab` variants `hover`, `beta`, `beta-hover`, `beta-active` (new), `shell-topbar` (Use Cases tab uses the beta variants in all four variants). **Decision:** `chr1164-beta-badge-on-tabs`. **New tokens:** `chrome-light.info` #2a3edb, `chrome-light.info-subtle` #dfe4ff, `chrome-dark.info` #a8b8ff, `chrome-dark.info-subtle` #22305a, `size.badge-h` 14px, `typography.ui-badge` 9.5px. The light values are the existing blue `color.accent` / `color.accent-tint`. The chrome had no blue, so the themed pair was needed for dark. ### Structure In `src/preview/index.html`, inside the existing button, after the label text: ```html ``` ### CSS `style.css`: add `--chrome-info: #2a3edb; --chrome-info-subtle: #dfe4ff;` to `:root`, `--chrome-info: #a8b8ff; --chrome-info-subtle: #22305a;` to `:root[data-theme="dark"]`, plus `--size-badge-h: 14px; --ui-badge: 9.5px;` to `:root`. The button: `display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:var(--space-2xs)` (2px). Keep `align-self:stretch`, the padding and everything else of `.chrome-tab`. | `.chrome-badge` | Value | |---|---| | display | `inline-flex; align-items:center; flex:none` | | height | `var(--size-badge-h)` 14px | | padding | `0 var(--space-xs)` 4px | | border | none | | radius | `var(--radius-pill)` | | background | `var(--chrome-info-subtle)` | | color | `var(--chrome-info)` | | font | `var(--ui-badge)` 9.5px, weight 500, `line-height:1` | | raise | `position:relative; top:-4px` (superscript-like: the badge centre sits 4px above the label centre; its top is about 2.5px above the label's line box, its bottom about 2px above the baseline) | | text | "Beta", sentence case | The design draws the raise as a wrapper with `padding-bottom: 8px` in a centred group, because the design tool cannot express a negative offset with a token. In CSS, `position:relative; top:-4px` gives the same picture and does not affect layout. Tab height stays 44px (measured); the tab gets about 30px wider. Nothing else in `#view-tabs` moves vertically. ### States | Tab state | Label | Underline | Badge | |---|---|---|---| | default | `--chrome-text-secondary` | none | unchanged | | hover | `--chrome-text` | none | unchanged | | pressed (`aria-pressed="true"`) | `--chrome-text`, weight 500 | 2px `--chrome-text`, spans label + badge | unchanged | | focus-visible | existing tab focus ring around label + badge | | unchanged | The badge keeps one look in every state: no `.chrome-tab:hover .chrome-badge` or `[aria-pressed] .chrome-badge` rules. Its weight is set explicitly (500) so it does not depend on the tab's weight. Contrast (badge text on badge fill): light #2a3edb on #dfe4ff = 5.9:1, dark #a8b8ff on #22305a = 6.7:1. ### Accessibility - The badge is plain text inside the button, so it is part of the accessible name. The visually hidden ", " makes screen readers say **"Use Cases, Beta, toggle button, not pressed"**. No `aria-label` (it would replace the visible text); the visible "Use Cases Beta" stays contained in the name (WCAG 2.5.3 Label in Name). - `.visually-hidden`: the shell has only scoped copies (`.mcp-visually-hidden`, `.uc-visually-hidden`); reuse one or add one shared utility with the same rules. - No `title` tooltip, no extra role, no live region. Keyboard shortcut and `aria-pressed` handling stay as they are. ### Out of scope No tooltip or explanation of "Beta", no dismiss, no badge on other tabs. A later beta tab gets the same markup (design: switch its `chrome-tab` to the `beta*` variants).
